operation: All original raw files archived without rewriting or deleting originals; ZIP entries and still-present originals rechecked against every indexed SHA256.
receipt_scope: Wrapper receipt covers packing and verification through completion. This source copy and publication note were appended afterward and are publication metadata, not retroactively metered execution.
recovery_command: python -m zipfile -e connected-reproduction-00N-complete-raw.zip NEW_DIRECTORY; compare every extracted relative path/byte count/SHA256 with the corresponding MANIFEST.json.
loose_files: Top-level execution report/state/identity markers and bounded receipt/stdout/stderr remain readable without unpacking.
